first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing makes a targeted SMB pricing response the most immediate route to protect qualified acquisition, but the inherited evidence does not yet establish durable value or retention under discounting. Verify the pricing result for cohort quality, discount scope, and longer-term revenue, while verifying onboarding evidence because completion and activation are also declining. Run only a small, tightly targeted test until downstream value is confirmed.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified record directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than only top-of-funnel volume. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified acquisition lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and failed the sustainable-growth objective.
